abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks, such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on. At tier 2: You can choose to become specialized in the same attack method you chose at tier 1, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement). At tier 6: You can become an expert in a specific attack method (either the one you chose at tier 1 or another weapon skill you’re already specialized in), but you must gain the skill normally.

abilities.name: Press Advantage
abilities.description: When your damage‑dealing attack roll is 17 or higher, you deal +1 damage with the attack. If you roll a 19 or 20, you inflict the extra damage regardless of whether you choose to deal additional damage or take a special minor or major effect. Successive Attack (2 Speed or Might): Once per turn if you take down a foe, you can immediately make another attack on that same turn against a new foe within your reach as an extra action on your turn. You can use this ability with melee attacks and ranged attacks.

system.description:
A Dungeon Fantasy Type focused on fighter archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Fantasy. Subgenre: Dungeon Fantasy. Primary Pools: might, speed.
